attributes.name: ypy-prompt
attributes.description: Asks the user a question before the request, sends the answer in the `YPY-Prompt` header and aborts the request when the user cancels. Define `window.ypyPrompt` for a custom synchronous dialog.

events.name: ypy:prompt
events.description: Fires on the element after the user answered. Cancel it to abort the request.

headers.name: YPY-Prompt
headers.description: The answer the user gave to `ypy-prompt`, URI-encoded.
